title: IDQL: Implicit Q-Learning as an Actor-Critic Method with Diffusion Policies

methods.one_paragraph_description: Train Q and V with IQL expectile loss (tau) on the offline dataset; separately train a diffusion (DDPM, LN_Resnet score net, T=5 VP schedule) behavior-cloning policy mu(a|s). At runtime, sample N actions from the diffusion behavior model and execute the argmax under Q (one-hot reweighting of the implicit policy). '-A' = any amount of tuning / reported results.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL (implicit Q-learning generalized as an actor-critic method with diffusion policies; 'we generalize IQL into an actor-critic method')

actor_lr_schedule.value: cosine decay over number of actor grad steps
actor_lr_schedule.quote: Actor Cosine Decay [32]                  Number of Actor Grad Steps

critic_value_network.quote: The critic and value network follow the same parameterization as in IQL [26] (2 Layer MLP with hidden size 256 and ReLU activations).

actor_architecture.quote: We depict the architecture used in the LN_Resnet described in Section 5. We use hidden dim size 256 and n = 3 blocks for our practical implementation.

reward_preprocessing.quote: As in IQL, we standardize the rewards for the locomotion tasks and we subtract rewards by one for the antmaze tasks.

action_selection.value: argmax over N diffusion samples by Q
action_selection.quote: In practice, we also found that simply taking the action with the highest Q-value tends to yield better performance at evaluation time, which corresponds to selecting w(s, a) to be a one-hot.

methods.one_paragraph_description: Train Q and V with IQL expectile loss (tau) on the offline dataset; separately train a diffusion (DDPM, LN_Resnet score net, T=5 VP schedule) behavior-cloning policy mu(a|s). At runtime, sample N actions from the diffusion behavior model and execute the argmax under Q (one-hot reweighting of the implicit policy). '-1' = one-hyperparameter regime: only tau tuned per domain (tau=0.7 for all locomotion).
